question_text:
What is the primary cause of lightning during a thunderstorm? 
(Garaj (Thunderstorm) ke dauran vidyut (lightning) ka mukhya kaaran (primary cause) kya hai?)

options.text:
Accumulation of negative and positive charges in clouds 
(Baadalon mein nakaaraatmak aur sakaaraatmak aavesh ka ikattha hona)

Collision of two huge clouds 
(Do bade baadalon ka takrana)

Evaporation of water from the sea 
(Samudra se paani ka vashpikaran)

High speed winds blowing together 
(Tez hawaon ka ek saath chalna)

explanation:
During a thunderstorm, air currents move upward and water droplets move downward. This vigorous movement causes separation of charges due to friction. Positive charges collect near the upper edges of clouds and negative charges near the lower edges. 
(Garaj ke dauran hawa aur paani ki boondon ke beech gharshan (friction) se aavesh (charges) alag ho jaate hain.)
distractor_rationale:
Option B is a common misconception; clouds don't 'collide' like cars, charges build up due to internal friction. Options C and D occur during storms but do not directly cause electric discharge. 
(Option B ek aam galatfehmi (misconception) hai; baadal aapas mein takrate nahi hain, balki gharshan se aavesh bante hain.)

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand that lightning is a massive electric discharge caused by charge separation.
common_misconceptions: Lightning is caused by clouds physically crashing into each other.
ai_context.hint: Think about what happens when you rub a balloon on your hair. What builds up?

question_text:
You are caught in a thunderstorm in an open field with no shelter nearby. What is the safest position to take? 
(Aap ek khule maidan (open field) mein hain aur garaj (thunderstorm) ho rahi hai. Sabse surakshit (safest) sthiti kya hai?)

options.text:
Lie completely flat on the ground 
(Zameen par poori tarah late jana)

Stand under the tallest isolated tree 
(Sabse oonche ped ke neeche khade hona)

Squat low on the ground with hands on knees and head between them 
(Zameen par ukdoo (squat) baith kar sir ghutnon ke beech rakhna)

Run as fast as possible in any direction 
(Kisi bhi disha mein tez daudna)

explanation:
Squatting low makes you the smallest possible target while minimizing your contact area with the ground. Lying flat increases the ground area your body touches, making you a better conductor for ground currents. 
(Ukdoo (squat) baithne se aap sabse chhota lakshya (target) ban jaate hain. Letne se zameen se aapka sampark (contact) badh jata hai, jo khatarnak hai.)
distractor_rationale:
Option A is dangerous because ground currents from a nearby strike can pass through your whole body. Option B is highly dangerous because tall objects attract lightning. 
(Option A aur B khatarnak hain kyonki ped aur zameen dono vidyut ko aakarshit karte hain.)

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply knowledge of electric discharge to real-life safety protocols.
common_misconceptions: Lying flat is the best way to hide from lightning.
ai_context.hint: If lightning strikes nearby, electricity travels across the ground. You want as little of your body touching the floor as possible.

question_text:
What is the outermost layer of the Earth called, which is fragmented into tectonic plates? 
(Prithvi ki sabse baahari parat (outermost layer) ko kya kehte hain, jo tukdon (plates) mein banti hai?)
explanation:
The Earth's outermost layer is called the crust. It is not a continuous piece but is broken into plates known as tectonic plates, which are in continuous motion. 
(Prithvi ki sabse baahari parat ko crust (bhooparpati) kehte hain, jo kai tukdon (tectonic plates) mein banti hui hai.)
distractor_rationale:
The Mantle and Core are much deeper inner layers. Earthquakes happen due to the movement of the broken pieces of the outer Crust. 
(Mantle aur Core prithvi ki gehri (deep) paratein hain. Bhukamp oopari crust ki halchal se aata hai.)

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify the basic structure of the Earth in relation to earthquakes.
common_misconceptions: The ground we walk on is one single solid shell.
ai_context.hint: Think of an egg. Which part of an egg corresponds to this layer?

question_text:
Which instrument is used to record the seismic waves generated by an earthquake? 
(Bhukamp se utpann bhukampeey tarangon (seismic waves) ko record karne ke liye kis yantra (instrument) ka upyog kiya jata hai?)
explanation:
A seismograph is an instrument that records the seismic waves caused by earthquakes. The Richter scale is used to express the magnitude, but it is not an instrument itself. 
(Seismograph ek yantra hai jo bhukamp ki tarangon ko record karta hai. Richter scale kewal ek paimaana (scale) hai.)
distractor_rationale:
Option C (Richter Scale) is a scale of measurement, not a recording machine. Option A measures air pressure, and Option B detects static electric charge. 
(Richter scale ek paimaana hai, machine nahi. Electroscope aavesh (charge) maapta hai.)

ai_context.learning_goal: Differentiate between the scale of measurement and the recording instrument for earthquakes.
common_misconceptions: The Richter scale is a physical machine with a needle.
ai_context.hint: The word ends with '-graph' which means 'to write or record'. What writes the waves?

question_text:
If an earthquake strikes while you are indoors, you should immediately stand right next to a tall, heavy bookshelf for protection. 
(Agar aap ghar ke andar hain aur bhukamp aata hai, to aapko turant kisi bhari, oonchi almari (bookshelf) ke paas khade ho jana chahiye.)
explanation:
False. Standing next to tall, heavy furniture is very dangerous because it could easily topple over and crush you during the shaking. Instead, you should take shelter under a sturdy table or desk. 
(Galat. Bhari aur oonchi almari (furniture) bhukamp ke dauran gir sakti hai. Aapko majboot table ke neeche chhupna chahiye.)
distractor_rationale:
Some people think large objects provide a shield, but in an earthquake, falling objects are the biggest cause of injury. 
(Kuch log sochte hain ki badi cheezein suraksha dengi, lekin bhukamp mein girti hui cheezein sabse bada khatra hoti hain.)

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply structural safety rules during an active earthquake.
common_misconceptions: Heavy furniture acts like a protective wall during a quake.
ai_context.hint: What might happen to a tall bookshelf when the ground shakes violently side to side?
